- **8062**: Bars use of any funds to modify NIP appropriation account structure, unclassified P/R/O-1 presentation, apportionment, or allotment/obligation/disbursement processes. Allows mergers/changes at or below Expenditure Center if consistent. DNI/SECDEF may jointly study alternate financial-management processes only for auditability/fiscal reporting; must include counterintelligence risk assessment; affected agencies must certify auditability/reporting/no adverse CI effects; proposals/certifications to defense/intelligence committees within 30 days after certifications.
- **8063–8065**: Allows FY transfer up to **$11,000,000 each** from O&M Army/Navy/Air Force to Fisher House central funds under **10 U.S.C. 2493(d)**. Appropriates **$5,000,000**, no-year, only grant to Fisher House Foundation for construction/furnishing additional Fisher Houses on SECDEF national-interest determination. Up to **$1,000,000** O&M Navy transferable to John C. Stennis Center Trust Fund under **2 U.S.C. 1105**.
- **8066–8070**: Prohibits Navy command/control changes giving Fleet Forces Command control over Pacific Fleet forces absent written proposal to Appropriations Committees; implement after 30 days unless objection; must not impair USINDOPACOM. **10 U.S.C. 3601** notices also to Defense Appropriations Subcommittees. Israeli Cooperative Programs: **$500,000,000** total—Iron Dome **$80,000,000**; SRBMD **$127,000,000**; SRBMD coproduction **$40,000,000**; upper-tier/Arrow 3 coproduction **$80,000,000**; Arrow System Improvement **$173,000,000**; transfer authority additional. Shipbuilding prior-year cost increases: **$1,648,559,000** available to **Sept. 30, 2024**, allocated to listed Carrier Replacement, Virginia, DDG-51, LPD-17, SSC, LCS, TAO, CVN, T-ATS, T-AGOS amounts. Intelligence funds deemed authorized under **50 U.S.C. 3094(a)(1)** until FY2024 Intelligence Authorization Act.
- **8071–8081**: Bars reprogramming to create/initiate new PPA except immediate national security need with prior written notice. Bars nuclear-armed missile-defense interceptors. Bars decommissioning any LCS, USS Germantown, USS Tortuga. SCN subdivisions same purpose for **31 U.S.C. 1553(b)**; 1% applies to total appropriation. Bars reducing/disestablishing 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron below funded WC-130 level; permits other missions in non-hurricane season. Bars transfer of Army TUAV authorities; Army retains MQ-1C Gray Eagle responsibility/control. Foreign intelligence integration only if lawfully collected/processed; U.S. persons handled under Fourth Amendment/EO 12333. ODNI funds one-year except R&T to **Sept. 30, 2025** and real property to **Sept. 30, 2026**. DNI baseline report due 60 days; no NIP reprogramming/transfer before report absent emergency certification. NIP reprogramming/transfer under **50 U.S.C. 3024(d)** requires 30-day notice, reducible for urgent national security, for new starts, terminations ≥**$10,000,000**, transfers into/out of NIP, between appropriations, or classified-annex cumulative changes. DNI may transfer up to **$1,500,000,000** NIP with OMB approval for unforeseen higher priorities; not for congressional denials; multiple reprogramming request before **June 30, 2024**.
- **8082–8099**: DAWDA transfers under **10 U.S.C. 1705(e)(1)** subject to **§8005**. Federal contracts >**$1,000,000** require contractor/subcontractor arbitration restrictions for Title VII/sexual assault/harassment tort claims; unenforceable-agreement exception; SECDEF/Deputy waiver for national security with public/congressional notice 15 business days before award.
